summary.text: Kyle Hoffman is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 116 since January 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kyle Hoffman earned a B.S. in agriculture technology and management from Kansas State University in 1994, and his professional experience includes owning and operating Central Fuel & Service.
Hoffman took office representing Kansas House District 116 on January 10, 2011.

In the 2025–2026 session he chaired the Information Technology Committee and was assigned to the Appropriations Committee, the Calendar and Printing Committee, the House Interstate Cooperation Committee and the J. Russell (Russ) Jennings Corrections and Juvenile Justice Oversight Committee.
